prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1079; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this office now represents our client in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred while our client was turning left and was struck by another vehicle. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is undergoing ongoing medical treatment.

Effective immediately, all communication regarding this claim should be directed exclusively to this office. Please do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. Any inquiries from your company or its representatives should be routed through our firm.

We request that you provide a certified copy of the policy declarations page, including the bodily injury and property damage liability limits applicable to the insured driver, along with any other coverage information that may apply to this loss.

Finally, we demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dashcam or telematics data, vehicle inspection records, recorded statements, claim file notes, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained.
